# Columbia Pictures Aquaverse — Pattaya, Thailand

> Columbia Pictures Aquaverse is Southeast Asia's first Hollywood movie-themed water park, located in Na Jomtien, Pattaya (Sattahip, Chonburi). Opened in 2022, the park features 9 themed zones based on Sony/Columbia Pictures franchises including Ghostbusters, Jumanji, Hotel Transylvania, Zombieland, and Surf's Up.

## Key Facts
- Location: 888 Moo 8, Na Jomtien, Sattahip, Chonburi 20250, Thailand
- Hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM (daily)
- Online ticket: THB 1,171 via Klook (gate price THB 1,595)
- Children 0–2 years: free admission
- 9 themed zones, 20+ rides and attractions
- Uses cashless credit-band system for food and retail
